column1: Can I cache a rustdoc Id and use it later?
column5: rustdoc-json: no: an Id is a position in one document. Adding an unrelated item shifts it

column1: Can I script these tools and trust the exit code?
column5: hir: sometimes: ssr exits 1 on a refused rule, but parse exits 0 on source it could not parse

column1: How do I analyse code that does not compile?
column5: hir: needs a resolvable program | mir: needs a successful compilation | rustdoc-json: needs rustdoc to succeed

column1: How do I load a real Cargo project into an analysis database?
column5: hir: operates on a database; it does not create one | cargo-metadata: describes the project without loading anything

column1: How do I rewrite every occurrence of a pattern?
column5: syntax: can match structurally but will not check that the replacement resolves

column1: How do I write my own dataflow analysis?
column5: dataflow: if you remember AnalysisDomain or GenKillAnalysis: both are gone, merged into Analysis and removed respectively

column1: Is this item deprecated, or gated behind a feature?
column5: rustdoc-json: for the feature half: a gated-off item is absent entirely, with no record that it exists

column1: Is this local initialised at this point?
column5: mir: gives the graph; whether a fact holds along every path is a fixpoint over it

column1: Is this local live here?
column5: mir: the same reason: liveness is derived over the graph, not recorded in it

column1: What are the call edges out of this function?
column5: rustdoc-json: has no call graph of any kind | hir: can resolve a call it is shown, but does not enumerate a body's calls as a graph

column1: What does this crate expose publicly?
column5: hir: sees every item whether public or not, and has no notion of the documented surface | cargo-metadata: knows the package, not a single item inside it

column1: What does this function do?
column5: rustdoc-json: contains no function bodies at all -- the single most common wrong turn | syntax: has the body as text with nothing resolved

column1: What does this macro expand to?
column5: syntax: holds the invocation unexpanded -- MACRO_CALL is as far as it goes

column1: What is the crate graph and which features are on?
column5: cargo-metadata: with --no-deps the resolve field is null, which is not the same as no dependencies | project-load: builds its own graph for analysis, which is not the Cargo view

column1: What is the exact signature, generics and bounds of an item?
column5: syntax: has the signature as written, but not the resolved paths in it

column1: What node kinds can appear in a Rust syntax tree?
column5: rustdoc-json: documents the types, not the grammar they encode

column1: What traits does this type implement?
column5: hir: also answers, and is the right choice when the type is local or private rather than a published API

column1: What type does this expression have?
column5: syntax: records the type as written and infers nothing | rustdoc-json: has no expressions | mir: has types, but the expression structure is gone

column1: Where exactly is this in the file, including comments and whitespace?
column5: hir: discards trivia | mir: keeps spans but not the text between them

column1: Where is this symbol defined, and where is it used?
column5: syntax: can find the spelling but cannot tell two different items with the same name apart | rustdoc-json: has no call sites

column1: Where is this value dropped?
column5: syntax: drops appear nowhere in the source | hir: knows ownership but not drop placement

column1: Which MIR am I looking at -- before or after optimisation?
column5: mir: asking for 'the MIR' is ambiguous: built, analysis and runtime differ

column1: Which branch runs, and under what condition?
column5: hir: has the expression tree, not the graph | syntax: has the if as written

column1: Which impl does this method call resolve to?
column5: rustdoc-json: lists impls but cannot resolve a call site | syntax: sees a method name and nothing else

column1: Which layer should I use at all?
Which rust-analyzer version am I actually running?
column5: hir: the binary reports a rustc release number; there is no published mapping to an ra_ap crate version

column1: Which rustdoc format version am I parsing?
column5: rustdoc-json: the toolchain's own version does not tell you: docs.rs serves whatever its fleet built, and rustdoc-types 0.61.0 is itself served at format 60

column1: Why is this item missing from the documentation I generated?
column5: rustdoc-json: three different causes look identical: not public, cfg-gated off, or in a private module
